{{Otheruses|Weaver}}
A '''weaver''' was a very fast type of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] designed for intercity transport. It had a top speed of 65 kilometers per hour. Although it was a small transport designed with the capacity to carry only a single being, it had just enough space to carry a second passenger in emergencies. It was highly maneuverable even in urban areas densely populated by crowds of other [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] creatures. It was equipped with gyroscopic sensors which assisted the operator by automatically compensating for many sudden terrain hazards, such as ice or oil slicks.

The controls stood atop a column which rose from the meter-wide floor plate. After setting the desired speed and navigational options, the operator stood upon the floor plate while gripping adjustable handlebars, shifting their body mass to steer. A light repulsor field acted as a windscreen to protect the pilot.
